commit.message:
feat: migrate to SDK 0.6.0 (wasmtime Component Model + WIT-driven types) (#17)

## Summary

Migrate to astrid-sdk 0.6.0 targeting wasm32-wasip2 (Component Model).

- Remove `extism-pdk` dependency
- Update `astrid-sdk` to 0.6.0 (from crates.io)
- Migrate IPC APIs: `recv_bytes`/`poll_bytes` → typed `PollResult`
- Migrate `hooks::trigger(&[u8])` → `hooks::trigger(&str)`
- Migrate `log::log("level", msg)` → typed `log::info(msg)` etc.
- Add `[[topic]]` declarations to Capsule.toml where applicable
- Build target: wasm32-wasip2

feat: save_identity tool — LLM persists identity after onboarding (#15)

The LLM needs to persist its chosen identity after the onboarding
conversation. save_identity writes both KV state and spark.toml. The
onboarding prompt instructs the LLM to call it.

fix: auto-detect existing spark.toml on first build request (#13)

## Summary

- When KV state says `onboarded=false` but `home://.config/spark.toml`
exists on disk, auto-load the config and set `onboarded=true`
- Guards against empty stubs (requires non-empty `callsign`)
- Makes the system resilient to KV resets

## Dependencies

Requires SDK 0.5.3+ (`fs::read_to_string` status prefix from
unicity-astrid/sdk-rust#25) to avoid WASM traps on file-not-found.

## Test plan

- [x] Spark persona "Nova" loaded from spark.toml on persistent daemon
- [x] Onboarding prompt shown when no spark.toml exists
- [x] Verified via `--snapshot-tui` in smoke test #604

Part of unicity-astrid/astrid#604

chore: bump astrid-sdk to 0.5.2 (#12)

Bumps `astrid-sdk` to 0.5.2 which fixes `tool_describe` `FnResult`
compatibility.

fix: store spark.toml in home:// not cwd:// (#11)

## Summary

spark.toml is the LLM's persistent identity — it belongs in
`home://spark.toml` (principal home), not the project CWD. It should
follow the user across all projects.

Also removes `cwd_dir` env entirely — identity has no project-scoped
files.

Part of unicity-astrid/astrid#601.

## Changes

- `src/lib.rs`: spark path changed to `home://spark.toml`
- `Capsule.toml`: capabilities changed to `fs_read/write = ["home://"]`,
`[env]` removed

## Test Plan

- [x] Builds cleanly against `wasm32-wasip1`
- [ ] `/identity-export` writes to
`~/.astrid/home/{principal}/spark.toml`
- [ ] `/identity-import` reads from same path

refactor: rename workspace:// VFS scheme to cwd:// (#10)

## Summary

Renames `workspace://` VFS scheme to `cwd://` across this capsule
(companion to core rename PR).

`workspace://` implied a structured project workspace concept, but the
scheme simply maps to the daemon's CWD at boot. `cwd://` is accurate,
generic, and immediately understood.

Find-and-replace only — no behaviour change.

## Test plan

- [ ] Capsule builds cleanly against updated kernel
- [ ] Smoke test passes

chore: bump astrid-sdk to 0.5.0 (#9)

## Summary

Bump `astrid-sdk` dependency to 0.5.0.

SDK 0.5.0 rewires `#[astrid::tool]` to generate IPC interceptor arms
instead of the removed `astrid_tool_call` export. Non-tool capsules are
unaffected functionally — this is a straight version bump.

## Changes

- `astrid-sdk` version: `0.4.0` / `0.3.0` → `0.5.0`

## Test Plan

- [x] `cargo build --target wasm32-wasip1 --release` passes

feat: rename identity.v1 topics to spark.v1 (#8)

## Summary

Rename IPC topics from `identity.v1.*` to `spark.v1.*` to align with the
`astrid:spark` WIT interface name.

## Changes

- `identity.v1.request.build` → `spark.v1.request.build` in Capsule.toml
and src/lib.rs
- `identity.v1.response.ready` → `spark.v1.response.ready` in
Capsule.toml and src/lib.rs

### Re: topic string constants

Gemini suggests extracting hardcoded topic strings to constants. Valid
idea, but this is a cross-capsule concern — every capsule has hardcoded
topic strings. Extracting constants in one capsule without the others
creates inconsistency. Tracked as a follow-up when the SDK provides
generated constants from WIT definitions.

## Checklist

- [x] Capsule.toml topics updated
- [x] Source code topic strings updated

feat: add [imports]/[exports] interface declarations (#7)

## Summary

Replace old `[dependencies]` provides/requires string arrays with
`[imports]`/`[exports]` namespaced TOML tables using semver versioning.

## Changes

- Add `[imports.astrid]` and/or `[exports.astrid]` sections
- Remove old `[dependencies]` section (if present)
- Import versions use semver requirements (`^1.0`)
- Export versions use exact semver (`1.0.0`)

## Checklist

- [x] Capsule.toml updated

ci: add WASM release pipeline (#5)

Adds a release workflow that triggers on tag push (`v*`). Builds the
release WASM binary (`wasm32-wasip1`) and creates a GitHub release with
the `.wasm` file as a release asset.

This enables `astrid init` to download pre-built binaries instead of
building from source.

## Changes

- New `.github/workflows/release.yml` — tag-triggered WASM build and
release

feat: self-contained identity with KV state, onboarding, and import/export (#4)

## Summary

- Moves spark config from explicit `kv::get/set` calls to struct fields
on `IdentityBuilder`, backed by the `#[capsule]` macro's stateful KV
dispatch (`&mut self`)
- Adds `onboarded: bool` flag — on first boot the system prompt includes
a natural onboarding instruction asking the agent to introduce itself
and derive an identity from the conversation
- Skips the identity preamble until onboarding is complete so the model
has no pre-anchored name before the user interacts
- Adds `/identity-export` and `/identity-import` commands for persisting
spark config to `.astrid/spark.toml`
- Adds `set_identity` tool for the LLM to save the configured identity

## Test plan

- [x] Fresh install: confirm onboarding prompt fires and agent
introduces itself without a pre-set name
- [x] Call `set_identity` with config and confirm subsequent sessions
use the configured identity
- [x] Run `/identity-export` and confirm `.astrid/spark.toml` is written
- [x] Run `/identity-import` and confirm identity is loaded from file

chore: bump astrid-sdk to 0.3.0 (#3)

Bump astrid-sdk dependency from current version to 0.3.0.

feat: add tool descriptions and capsule-level docs (#2)

Add doc comments to tools and capsule impl blocks so LLMs get
descriptions when deciding which tool to call. Depends on
unicity-astrid/sdk-rust#7.

fix(deps): resolve astrid-sdk from crates.io registry (#1)

## Summary
- Remove local `path` override from `astrid-sdk` dependency that only
exists in the polyrepo workspace
- Bump `astrid-sdk` from `0.1.1` to `0.2.0` (published on crates.io)
- CI was failing because the path `../../core/crates/astrid-sdk` does
not exist when only this repo is checked out

## Test plan
- CI should now resolve `astrid-sdk` from crates.io and pass the build
- Verified locally: `cargo check --target wasm32-unknown-unknown`
succeeds against published 0.2.0
docs: add README and LICENSE files consistent with kernel repo
ci: simplify workflow, resolve core deps from registry
